value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. The first one is going in on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, with a target opening in fall 2027. The closest open ones I found are the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga, which a deals site says also serves Oakville (not confirmed by Costco), and the existing Burlington location, though I couldn't confirm its address or hours. I also can't tell exact distances from where you are.
